title: Surface encoder backend preference in settings
summary: Expose the dormant EncoderBackend setting in the WebView video detail builder, keep it save-only for now, and update active Phase 6 docs/inventories to reflect the surfaced-but-dormant state.
reason: The encoder breadth work added a backend-owned EncoderBackend key, but the settings builder did not yet surface it for operator round-trip. This closes that UI gap without changing encode selection or activating new hardware encoders.
behavior_before: EncoderBackend could round-trip through backend config/schema surfaces and capability diagnostics, but the WebView video detail builder had no direct control for saving the preference.
behavior_after: The WebView video detail builder includes an EncoderBackend select with auto/nvenc/qsv/amf/cpu choices, syncs it from saved config with auto fallback, and writes it through the existing backend-validated settings patch path. Runtime encode selection still follows VideoCodec.
tests_added: Extended tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui to assert EncoderBackend builder metadata, HTML control presence, and sync wiring.
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView builder metadata/control/sync changes, remove the related static-test assertions, and restore the docs/inventory text that described EncoderBackend as not directly surfaced.
